$comment: modern palettes. Shape as in academic-light: palettes by name, each with a kind (categorical | sequential | diverging), colors with localized names, and role mappings. The categorical palette passes `checkPalette` (cli/palettes.js) on the theme background #ffffff: at least 3:1 contrast per color and CIEDE2000 >= 8 between every pair under simulated protanopia, deuteranopia and tritanopia. See README.md.

modern.description: Deep blue, rose and teal from the approved mockup (the rose darkened for 4.5:1 text contrast on the surface), then amber, violet and green chosen to stay at least 3:1 on white and at least CIEDE2000 10 from every other color under simulated color-vision deficiency. Ordered so the first three series are the most distinct.
modern.source: stepdeck. Blue #1d4ed8, rose and teal #0d9488 from the default-theme mockup; amber, violet and green chosen by stepdeck.

viridis.description: Viridis, perceptually uniform and readable in grey and with color-vision deficiency. A fill scale: its light end is not meant for thin marks on white.
viridis.source: viridis, by Stéfan van der Walt and Nathaniel Smith (matplotlib), released under CC0.

blue-red.description: Blue to red through a light grey midpoint; the two arms stay distinct with color-vision deficiency. A fill scale: the midpoint is meant to sit near the background.
blue-red.source: ColorBrewer RdBu (5 classes), Cynthia Brewer, Mark Harrower and The Pennsylvania State University, Apache License 2.0.
